dedupe_resolutions.notes: The energy secretary's possible crude-quality exchange is a proposed implementation mechanism for the already-recorded Venezuelan-oil and SPR announcement, not a separate action or completed exchange.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement.

rejected_candidates.title: No new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The validated fallback remained at 36,043 posts. The newest post was still published September 2 at 11:18:19 PM EDT; no later post existed to evaluate as an action lead by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Justice Department work with X on attempted account-recovery attack
rejected_candidates.reason: The same thin investigation announcement remained without a charge, warrant, public filing, victim finding or material investigative detail and therefore did not advance beyond the prior withheld lead.

rejected_candidates.title: Failed House amendment to cap the Supreme Court at nine justices
rejected_candidates.reason: The congressional messaging proposal failed 212–206, far short of the required two-thirds threshold, and produced no administration action or operative constitutional change.

rejected_candidates.title: Lafayette Park fence and White House visitor-center plans
rejected_candidates.reason: The National Capital Planning Commission had begun review but had not voted, approved construction, issued a contract or identified an operative funding decision by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Thomson Reuters C-Track cybersecurity incident
rejected_candidates.reason: The private vendor's breach affected court customers but did not establish a Trump-administration action, federal finding or court ruling in the reviewed window.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine regulations, campaign events and duplicate reporting
rejected_candidates.reason: Antidumping reviews, information collections, a Christmas-tree referendum, campaign scheduling and repeated accounts of already-recorded actions did not clear the national materiality and lifecycle thresholds.

rejected_candidates.title: Anonymous-source and prospective claims
rejected_candidates.reason: Consequential claims resting mainly on unnamed sources still lacked sufficient independent confirmation, while other statements did not establish a signed instrument, implemented action, disbursement or measured result.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: Updated, unit-specific measurements remain separate discovery inputs and contribute zero canonical entries by default. No upstream archive item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.

corrections.summary: This release repairs two completed enforcement outcomes omitted from the preceding September 2 review: the EEOC-Ford conciliation agreement announced September 1 and Reuters' September 2 disclosure that Boeing paid FAA's full civil penalty in January. Both retain their actual event chronology and precise settlement or payment status rather than being presented as new post-boundary actions.
